kiel-boknis-schlei-north-loop.title: Kiel · Boknis, Schlei and North Loop
kiel-boknis-schlei-north-loop.slogan: Open coast, Schlei crossings and enough villages to keep it honest.
kiel-boknis-schlei-north-loop.story: Open coast, Schlei crossings and enough villages to keep it honest. The best part sits around Boknis Eck viewpoint, Kappeln bridge, Schleswig return, while Eckernförde lunch keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

places-villages-on-kashiragashima-island.story: On the way it passes Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado, Nagasaki Shipyard/ Mitsubishi Former Patte and back through Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado. It stays on the island.

es-rias-baixas-coastal-loop.slogan: Rias Baixas Coastal Loop – 125 km between Vigo and Pontevedra
es-rias-baixas-coastal-loop.story: Repeated coastal bends, headlands and frequent viewpoint stops. It also links naturally to Atlantic Islands and Galician estuaries.
